scope: Read only the 24 signed 851c original-opponent training games on physical maps 621758460 through 621758465. Keep all six maps, twelve matched map-seat groups, every full trajectory and all 288 scheduled steps. No original games, formal maps, or outside development rewards.
behavior: Use actual quantized 851c, dense logits of both owned towers, weights 0.75 and 0.25, original public-history prefixes, original fixed guard/residual and actual pair of legal physical joint orders. For every reached opportunity verify support and probabilities against the released actor; select by the order actually sent.
score: For each trajectory take its signed U minus independent same-map same-seat sibling U. Each map gets a sum of binary score gradients divided by 48 scheduled opportunities. Ignore deterministic slots' zero derivative. Constant denominator across all maps, with no arbitrary normalization of individual returns. Use truthful archived behavior probabilities as the exact operating point after dual-tower native/Torch parity. Both towers' full policy tensors participate; value-only tensors are excluded. The two siblings together are one statistical unit.
alignment: Report each map's L2, all 36 entries of each tower's raw Gram and cosine matrices, held-map dot and cosine against arithmetic mean of other five equal-weight map gradients. Also report the average of unit-normalized other-map gradients as a sensitivity diagnostic. Always print the 15 unordered distinct-map pairs and all negative cases.
decision: A small training update can proceed only if, separately in both towers, at least four of six held-map dots against the other five are positive AND the pooled off-diagonal sum of the 15 distinct-map dots is positive. This is a research screen, not an inferential claim. The earlier single-tower Sapling sign count (1 positive of 6) was already public before this diagnostic. If it reproduces, do not update weights and do not start games regardless of partner signs.
numeric: Stop on duplicate physical trajectories within map-seat, legal/physical support mismatch, nonfinite outputs, maximum absolute dual-tower probability error >0.00005 or selected logp error >0.00010. Independently cross-check Sapling's map cosine against the archived single-tower result.
unit_normalized_sensitivity: For each held map compare its unit vector against the arithmetic mean of the other five maps' unit gradients. This does not substitute a different weighting into the registered main screen.
